WiiCam v0.1.0

Copy apps/wiicam to sd:/apps/wiicam/.
To avoid duplicate Homebrew Channel entries, back up the old application folders
sd:/apps/wc04-camera-experimental/ and sd:/apps/wc04-camera/ to your computer,
then remove those old application folders from the SD card. Keep earlier ZIPs.
Do not delete sd:/wc04-camera/ or sd:/DCIM/100WC04/: these are existing media/log
locations and are unchanged. No photo renaming or migration is needed.

Confirm WiiCam 0.1.0 in Homebrew Channel and v0.1.0 at the bottom right.
Launch under IOS58. This app does not install or reload IOS.
A opens the viewfinder. + changes Photo/Video, 1 changes size, Left/Right changes
the photo timer, and 2 refreshes camera descriptors on the menu. A descriptor
result does not test streaming. During refresh, B cancels after pending USB work
returns; HOME waits for safe completion before exiting.
Photo: A takes a photo; B cancels a countdown or returns to the menu.
Video: A starts/stops silent MJPEG AVI, limited to 60 seconds or 128 MiB.
B stops recording and returns to the menu. HOME finalizes and exits.
If USB stopping waits indefinitely, unplug the camera to let IOS return.

Later hardware check: verify menu labels, HOME symbol, v0.1.0 and safe TV edges.
Refresh repeatedly, including B and HOME during refresh, then reopen viewfinder.
At both sizes, save one JPEG and a short silent AVI; check files and session.log.
Confirm timer cancellation, no-SD state, disconnect recovery and photo review.
The Panel UI and this new 0.1.0 binary await physical testing. Prior 0.3.4 capture
worked on the tested 0c45:6366 device at both sizes; other cameras are unproven.
No bulk USB, newer UVC controls, raw YUY2, audio or MP4 support is added.
This build uses direct Wii Remote buttons; there is no IR pointer navigation.

Private local testing build. Asset and software notices are in licenses/.
